calendar.matters:
ADDED TO UNCONTESTED CALENDAR FOR Osc For Change Of Name
Off Calendar Aug-29-2002 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: Judge Diane Wick (Dept. 611), clerk-beth wilber, reporter-brenda fields: Petitioner Einer Pierce Applegate is present and court and appears with her attorney, Merrisa Coleman. The ROA showed that proof of publication was filed with the court, but was not in the file. Ms. Coleman provides the Court with an endorsed filed copy. After a brief hearing the Court grants petition for a name change and a sex change.
